ℹ️ What's in the AI Digital Passport — and what's not

20 lessons, all drawn from Removes. The teaching content and evidence tasks are shared. Your Passport completion is tracked separately.

Follow six stages: understand AI; learn with it; create and decide; check what you see; consider consequences; test and redesign. Each lesson includes an artefact, success criteria and an unaided challenge.

Your notes and evidence stay on this device. Download work you want to keep. Previously completed lessons from the older Passport count only where the exact same Removes lesson is included; older saved work is retained.

Cached lessons can be read offline after a successful first load. External videos and AI tools need internet access. A completion certificate records participation, not independently verified mastery.
